{{Top|leg}}
An '''activation reader''' was a sensor that could be activated by means of DNA, a chip under the skin or skin decorations like [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].

A [[Raptors|Raptor]] nicknamed [[Green Hair]] utilized one to activate a [[Blaster/Legends|tripod-mounted blaster]] trying to escape from [[Lorn Pavan]] and [[Darsha Assant]] in an alley on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
